supported_observations: Grujic v2 states the critical-point profile first and weak-L3/2 only as an 'in particular' consequence

diagnosis: Critical Lorentz amplitude is the wrong representation for source-family uniqueness. It records distributional size but forgets the number/location of separated critical cores; therefore it cannot by itself type-check into the one-center critical-point morphology consumed by Grujic v2.
scope_boundary: This diagnosis applies to the bare representation/norm inference only. It does not diagnose the stronger Navier-Stokes-equation-specific implication from finite I, which may use dynamics, singular-point selection or additional compactness.
